subject.title: [Feature]: Mobile apps: read-only workspace file browser (browse, preview, share)

question: Should maintainers finish this feature by reviewing and landing the open iOS read-only workspace Files PR, or redirect the remaining work to a different workspace-file product/security direction?
rationale: The code gap is now narrowed to iOS, but the issue is maintainer-labeled and the feature reads arbitrary agent workspace files through operator clients, so automation should not choose the product/security boundary or PR supersession path.

options.title: Land the iOS read-only slice
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100767 as the remaining platform implementation, then close this issue once merged.

options.title: Redirect to full workspace API
options.body: Defer the mobile feature until the broader full workspace-management direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/61368 is approved.

options.title: Rescope before more app work
options.body: Keep Gateway and Android as landed but explicitly narrow or pause iOS/mobile exposure until security owners choose a stricter boundary.

recommendation.title: Land the iOS read-only slice
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100767 as the remaining platform implementation, then close this issue once merged.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this issue and authored the merged Gateway/Android pieces plus the open iOS implementation PR.
